listingTitle: Avoid removing the front of Python lists in loops
title: Avoid removing the front of Python lists in loops
why: list.pop(0) shifts every remaining element, so repeated front removal can produce quadratic work.
suggestion: Advance through an iterator or use collections.deque and popleft when queue semantics are required.
limitations: Only variables explicitly annotated as list or List, or assigned a list literal or list constructor, are tracked.
Aliases, reassignment, collection size, loop bounds, and intentionally small lists are not inferred.
